archive_verification.command:
python3 -B - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('docs/evidence/runs/2026-09-12-autonomous-paired-package')
index=json.loads((base/'index.json').read_bytes())
for name,meta in index['manifest'].items():
    raw=(base/name).read_bytes()
    assert len(raw)==meta['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==meta['sha256']
    assert raw==pathlib.Path(meta['original_path']).read_bytes()
assert len(index['manifest'])==index['files']==65
assert sum(v['bytes'] for v in index['manifest'].values())==index['total_bytes']==615614
review=json.loads((base/'review.json').read_bytes())
verify=json.loads((base/'verification.json').read_bytes())
outer=json.loads((base/'preflight-command.json').read_bytes())
assert review['status']=='passed' and verify['passed'] is True and outer['exit_code']==0
assert len(review['commands'])==12 and all(c['exit_code']==0 for c in review['commands'])
root=pathlib.Path(index['source_root'])
for command in review['commands']:
    for stream in ('stdout','stderr'):
        meta=command[stream]
        rel=pathlib.Path(meta['path']).relative_to(root)
        raw=(base/rel).read_bytes()
        assert len(raw)==meta['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==meta['sha256']
for name, package in review['packages'].items():
    assert verify['packages'][name]['wheel_sha256']==package['sha256']
    assert verify['packages'][name]['git_wheel_installed_package_files']==len(package['package_files'])
    assert verify['packages'][name]['record_checks']['installed']['sha256']==review['installed_records'][name]['sha256']
assert verify['help_isolation']['forbidden_events']==[]
assert review['license_runtime_validated'] is False and review['workers_started']==0
print(json.dumps({'passed':True,'copies_byte_exact':65,'text_bytes':615614,
 'commands':12,'all_command_exits':0,'workers_started':0,'pro_runtime_imported':False,
 'index_sha256':hashlib.sha256((base/'index.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'review_sha256':hashlib.sha256((base/'review.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 'verification_sha256':hashlib.sha256((base/'verification.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()},sort_keys=True))
